server-rules.title: 🌸 KUROGANE COMMUNITY GUIDELINES
server-rules.description:
🌷 1. RESPECT EVERYONE
No harassment, bullying, discrimination, threats, or intentionally targeting others.

💬 2. KEEP IT APPROPRIATE
NSFW, excessively graphic, or otherwise inappropriate content is prohibited.

📨 3. NO SPAMMING
Don't flood chats with messages, mentions, emojis, images, or repeated content.

📢 4. NO ADVERTISING
Don't advertise servers, games, accounts, products, or services without staff permission.

📂 5. USE CHANNELS CORRECTLY
Keep messages and posts in their designated channels.

🔗 6. NO HARMFUL CONTENT
Scams, malicious links, suspicious downloads, or content intended to harm/deceive members are prohibited.

🔐 7. RESPECT PRIVACY
Don't expose or share another person's private information without permission.

🎭 8. DON'T CAUSE DRAMA
Don't troll, provoke others, bait arguments, or repeatedly create unnecessary conflicts.

🎟️ 9. DON'T ABUSE SUPPORT
Don't spam tickets, reports, suggestions, or create joke requests.

👮 10. RESPECT STAFF DECISIONS
Follow reasonable staff instructions. Disputes should be handled through the proper support channels.

🏢 11. FOLLOW IN-GAME RULES
Office After Dark's gameplay rules still apply. Serious in-game violations may affect your standing in the community.

🌸 12. USE COMMON SENSE
Not everything can be individually listed. Finding loopholes doesn't make disruptive or harmful behavior acceptable.

🌺 Enjoy your stay at Kurogane Company! Keep the community comfortable and enjoyable for everyone.
